faq.q: What is the origin of Kagan?
faq.a: Kagan is associated with Turkish. Kagan is Turkish, from the Turkic title kağan, meaning 'khan, ruler'.
No — the underlying form is Turkish, not Arabic.
Kagan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Turkish-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
